eval_notes: Simulated platform-style batches: size=1024, shuffle seed=42, dates 96-119. T87 NN (w=1.0) + T75 LGB (w=1.5), conformal band per-sym.

V1_multiplicative.description: batch_med/baseline -> adapt_factor -> thr /= adapt_factor. Strong batch -> lower thr (more trades). Cap: thr in [thr/2, thr*2].

V2_percentile_anchored.description: thr raised to 75th pct of positives / 25th pct of negatives. Top 25% always trades. Large PnL loss: too conservative on randomized batches.

V3_confidence_scaled.description: pred_scaled = pred * clip(|pred|/q75_abs, 0, 1). Low-confidence rows shrunk toward 0. Fewer trades, less PnL.

V4_hybrid.description: Adaptive only for extreme batches (ratio>=2x or <=0.5x baseline). On holdout, all shuffled batches fall in normal range -> identical to v2.

analysis.key_finding: All variants fail to beat v2 on shuffled holdout batches. Platform shuffles test points, making within-batch statistics noisy/uninformative. V4 correctly identifies this and falls back to original gate for normal batches. V1/V2/V3 lose due to threshold distortion on random batch mixes.
analysis.recommendation: Do NOT ship V1/V2/V3. V4 is safe (identical to v2). Adaptive thresholding is not beneficial under platform's random shuffle.

warning: Holdout deltas are unreliable predictors of platform performance. However, all variants <= v2 suggests no platform benefit.
